summary: Business documentaries, first review: watched the Stanley and Nokia contact sheets and scripts. No lesson added: none of the 3 Shorts is 2+ days old and none has retention numbers yet.
why: A lesson needs a drop or stayed number; all three Shorts have empty stayed, heldAfterHook and drops (Analytics at 0 views, the usual 2-3 day lag). Stanley leads on public views (1,080 on day 1 vs 8 and 6).

findings.title: Stanley (1,080 views) passes every lesson
findings.detail: Named in frame 1, sourced chart and poster, biggest figure at the payoff, one photo per beat, loops to the first shelf.

findings.title: Nokia passes every lesson
findings.detail: Named in frame 1, sourced press release and write-off, loops to the 3310; at 48 s it is the longest Short so far.

findings.title: No per-video Analytics yet
findings.detail: If still empty on 24 Nov for Shorts 4+ days old, it's a data bug for the auditor.
